lem: Decrease for saddle by coupling: Saddle Point Escape
nodes.statement:
Let Assumptions ass: Lipschitz and ass: Random perturbation hold, let $\epsilon_H>0$, and let the perturbation variance be given by (12). There exists $\rho_{\min,5}\geq1$ such that, for any $\rho\geq\rho_{\min,5}$ and any starting point $\mathbf{x}^{0}\in(\mathbb{R}^{n})^{m}$ satisfying
    \[
        \lambda_{\min}\!\left(\nabla^{2}\Psi_{\boldsymbol{\theta}^{0}}(\mathbf{x}^{0})\right)<-\epsilon_H,
    \]
    we have
    \begin{gather*}
        \mathbb{P}\Big[\exists\tau\in\{1,\ldots,r\}:~
        \Psi_{\boldsymbol{\theta}^{0}}(\mathbf{x}^{\tau})-\Psi_{\boldsymbol{\theta}^{0}}(\mathbf{x}^{0})
        \leq-\ell_s\Big]
        \geq\frac{1}{3}-(r^{2}+8r)\mathrm{e}^{-\rho},
    \end{gather*}
    where $\ell_s$ is defined in (26).
